title: Bloodborne

names.37: Lady Maria of the Astral Clocktower

notes: For the Bloodborne PC port. The game still decides when you've earned a trophy; the port writes it to its log (user\last_run.log), and Vault reads that log and never touches the game.
The port starts a fresh log every launch, so keep Vault running while you play. The Bloodborne platinum unlocks once you have every other main-game trophy.

testGuide.title: Kill the Cleric Beast
testGuide.detail: Defeat the Cleric Beast on the Great Bridge. "Cleric Beast" should pop up within a few seconds.
